question: What consequence follows from regarding the Lord as common?
premises: Some people remember the Lord as common.
Such people proceed to a dire destination.
That destination is described as the ocean of hell.
inference: Regarding the Lord as common leads those people to the ocean of hell.
uncertainties: The referent of enam is inferred from the preceding context as the Lord.
plain_english: Those who remember him as common go to the ocean of hell.
